steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Hmph, I'll admit, you're quite something to have pushed me this far.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Well then, I'll leave the rest to you, brave challengers.
As the battle ends, "Zoya" slowly fades away.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Phew, that was close... We almost got pulverized back there. Luckily, it was just Zoya's projection.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: It seems this world has some sort of nerfing mechanism in place. Otherwise, we would never have survived that.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: By the way... now that Zoya's gone, what will become of the Project: Dark app icon...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I think my portrait looks better—at least I’m not sticking my tongue out.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What do you know? It's totally #Quirky! Everyone's digging this vibe right now!
